about_ricardo.name: Ricardo Andrei Torres Medina
bio_paragraphs: I am a UX/UI Project Lead and Digital Product Designer based in Bogotá, Colombia. For over a decade, I have focused on designing critical digital infrastructure where clarity is paramount — from emergency healthcare triage systems to AI-powered epidemiological tracking and municipal GCP voice assistants.

My design philosophy is rooted in problem solving over visual decoration. I bridge human psychology, system architecture, and modern engineering constraints to create products that perform seamlessly at scale.

instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Use React Router DOM for deep case study micro-pages (e.g., /case-study/fundacion-santa-fe, /case-study/telefonica-movistar, /case-study/secretaria-salud-ai, /case-study/secretaria-gobierno-voice). Ensure clicking any signature case study opens the detailed microsite page smoothly with scroll-to-top.
instructions_to_main_agent.interactivity: Include an interactive Light/Dark mode toggle in the persistent header. Add smooth Lenis scrolling or Framer Motion scroll listeners. Include interactive tabs/filters on additional work and capabilities.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid to every nav item, button, link, form input, project card, case study tab, modal, dark mode toggle, and download action.
instructions_to_main_agent.smooth_transitions: Implement masked line reveals on hero text using Framer Motion variants. Add subtle hover tilt/scaling to case study images without breaking responsive grids.
